gaps.sentence: 'I'll see you tomorrow,' he said. He said he would see me ___.
gaps.explanation: Time expressions shift: tomorrow becomes the next day / the following day.

gaps.sentence: 'Please, please help me,' the woman begged. The woman begged ___ her.
gaps.explanation: Begging is reported as beg + somebody + to do something.

gaps.sentence: 'What are your plans for the weekend?' he asked. He asked what my plans for the weekend ___.
gaps.explanation: are → were: the copula backshifts like any other verb.

gaps.sentence: 'I was living in Berlin at the time,' she recalled. She recalled that she ___ living in Berlin at the time.
gaps.explanation: Past continuous backshifts to past perfect continuous: was living → had been living.

gaps.sentence: 'The flight leaves now,' the announcer said. The announcer said that the flight left ___.
gaps.explanation: Now becomes then in reported speech.

gaps.sentence: 'You should apply for the grant,' he told me. He ___ me to apply for the grant.
gaps.explanation: Advice is reported as advise + object + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: 'Get out of my way!' the guard snapped. The guard snapped at me ___ out of my way.
gaps.hint: snap at sb to do sth
gaps.explanation: The order is reported as snapped at me + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: She ___ that the storm had passed.
gaps.explanation: Without a personal object, use said (that)...; told requires an object.
